facts.text: Deborah ran a free gardening class for the community with her neighbor on the day before the session.

evidence.quote: Yesterday, me and my neighbor ran a free gardening class for the community, it was awesome!

facts.text: Deborah visited her mother's old house on Sunday and sat on a bench, feeling her presence and remembering her love.

evidence.quote: Last Sunday, I visited her old house and sat on a bench. It was a comforting experience, as if I could feel her presence guide me and remind me of her love.

facts.text: Deborah's mother had a passion for cooking and made meals full of love and warmth, with a special dish that filled the house with its smell.

evidence.quote: My mom had a big passion for cooking. She would make amazing meals for us, each one full of love and warmth. I can still remember the smell of her special dish, it would fill the house and bring us all together.
